title: razbiram screen-to-learn semantic snapshot v1
description: Sanitized DOM/ARIA snapshot of one stable page state. Artifact role: semantic-snapshot. Read by Detect, Extract, and Join stages.

captureId.description: Back-reference to the extension-capture.v1 manifest that owns this artifact.

captureState.description: Which role this state plays in the question/reveal pair. 'unknown' requires human review before joining.

questionFingerprint.description: SHA-256 join key. Computed from question text, sorted feedback-stripped option texts, card family, and origin scope. Identical across question and reveal states for the same question. See IDENTITY_ALGORITHMS.md.

stateFingerprint.description: SHA-256 dedup key for this specific DOM state. Includes checked states and raw option texts with feedback labels. Distinct between question and reveal states; identical across React rerenders of the same state.

capturedRegion.description: Present when captureMode is 'region'. Stores the CSS-pixel bounding rectangle drawn by the user and the device-pixel ratio at capture time. Cross-referenced from the extension-capture.v1 manifest when captureMode is 'region'.

nodes.description: Visible nodes under the question container, in DOM order. No scripts, styles, event handlers, hidden form values, or auth tokens.

normalizedRect.description: Bounding box in normalized viewport coordinates (0.0–1.0).

nodeId.description: Local stable node reference within this snapshot. Assigned in DOM order. Does not persist across captures.

nodeType.description: Semantic role within the question structure.

role.description: ARIA role or inferred semantic role.

accessibleName.description: Computed accessible name per ARIA in HTML.

visibleText.description: Raw visible text content as rendered, including any feedback annotations.

cleanText.description: NFC-normalized, whitespace-collapsed text with feedback annotations stripped. Used to compute questionFingerprint and optionId. See IDENTITY_ALGORITHMS.md for stripping rules.

checked.description: True if this radio/checkbox node is in the checked state.

expanded.description: True if this node is in the expanded state (e.g. disclosure widget).

disabled.description: True if this node is disabled or aria-disabled.

hasShadowRoot.description: True if this element hosts an open shadow root that was descended into.

containerRef.description: nodeId of the nearest ancestor node recorded in this snapshot, if any.
